quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to run, jump, and enjoy the fresh air"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: Fresh air, sunshine, and running are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We play outside in the afternoon to enjoy fresh air and exercise.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is a great way to get exercise while having lots of fun!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to greet your family with a cheerful hello"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: You say this cheerful greeting right after you wake up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good morning to greet our family as the day begins.
quests.funFact: A cheerful good morning can help set a happy tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to wake up your muscles with a big, gentle stretch"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You reach your arms up high and take a deep breath for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We stretch our body in the morning to wake up our muscles.
quests.funFact: Stretching gently in the morning can help wake up your whole body!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to give indoor plants a drink before they get thirsty"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: A small watering can helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the plants so they stay green and healthy.
quests.funFact: Plants use water and sunlight together to make their own food and grow!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to put everything back in its proper place"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: This covers your whole room, not just one small pile.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tidy our room in the evening to keep it neat and calm.
quests.funFact: A tidy room can help you find your favorite toys much faster the next day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to relax and enjoy a favorite show for a little while"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: A screen and a comfy couch are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We watch a little TV in the evening to relax.
quests.funFact: Balancing TV time with playing and reading helps keep your evening varied and fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to share a warm greeting as the day begins"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: A smile often comes along with these friendly words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good morning is a cheerful way to start the day.
quests.funFact: People around the world greet each other every morning in their own special way!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to fill a bowl for your furry friend"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: A food bowl and a happy, hungry pet are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We feed the pet in the morning so it has food for the day.
quests.funFact: Many pets look forward to feeding time as one of the best parts of their day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to explore the backyard or park with friends"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: A park, backyard, or playground is a perfect spot for this.
quests.explanation: That's right! Playing outside helps our bodies move and stay strong.
quests.funFact: Sunshine and fresh air can help you feel happy and full of energy!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to sit back and watch a fun program"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: This is a quiet, relaxing activity, done for just a little while.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watching TV for a little while is a fun way to unwind.
quests.funFact: Watching a favorite show together can be a cozy family activity!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to reach your arms up high and wake your body"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: This wakes up muscles that were resting all night.
quests.explanation: That's right! Stretching helps our body feel ready to move after sleeping.
quests.funFact: Even animals like cats and dogs love a good stretch after a nap!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to pour a little water into a plant's pot"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: Plants need this to stay green and grow strong.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watering plants means giving them a drink so they can grow.
quests.funFact: Some houseplants only need a little water once or twice a week!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to give your pet its breakfast before you leave"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: You do this for an animal friend at home, not for yourself.
quests.explanation: That's right! Feeding a pet means filling its bowl with food and water.
quests.funFact: Feeding a pet at the same time each day helps it feel safe and happy!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to get your feet ready for walking and running"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on our shoes before we head outside for the day.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to straighten up your whole room before bed"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: Clothes, books, and toys all find their spots during this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tidying a room means putting everything back in its place.
quests.funFact: Tidying up a little bit each day keeps a big mess from building up!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to make your space neat before you go to sleep"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: A neat, calm room is the result of this task.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy room helps us feel calm and ready for bed.
quests.funFact: A tidy room can help you find your favorite toys much faster the next day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to travel to school on wheels with other students"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You share this ride with many other students.
quests.explanation: That's right! Riding the bus is one way many students travel to school.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make sure your animal friend has food and water"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: Your pet waits patiently for you to do this each day.
quests.explanation: Well done! Taking care of a pet is a kind daily responsibility.
quests.funFact: Many pets look forward to feeding time as one of the best parts of their day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to smile and say hello to start the day"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: This is the opposite of the words we use at bedtime.
quests.explanation: Well done! A friendly good morning can make everyone feel happy.
quests.funFact: A cheerful good morning can help set a happy tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to help a houseplant stay green and healthy"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: You do this for something green sitting in a pot, not a pet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Plants need water, sunlight, and care to grow big and strong.
quests.funFact: Plants use water and sunlight together to make their own food and grow!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to travel to school on your own two feet"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You do this after breakfast, on the way to your classroom.
quests.explanation: That's right! Walking to school is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to place plates and spoons before a meal"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: You do this right before a meal begins, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting the table means placing plates and forks before a meal.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to enjoy games and sunshine outdoors"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: This is active and usually happens outdoors, not inside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Fresh air and sunshine make playing outside extra fun.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is a great way to get exercise while having lots of fun!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to gently move your arms and legs after sleeping"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You do this gently, often right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Well done! A gentle morning stretch can help us feel more awake.
quests.funFact: Stretching gently in the morning can help wake up your whole body!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to put your playthings back where they belong"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: You do this after playtime is finished, before dinner or bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cleaning up toys means putting playthings back where they belong.
quests.funFact: Putting toys away in the same spot each time makes them easy to find next time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to loosen up your body before a busy day"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You reach your arms up high and take a deep breath for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We stretch our body in the morning to wake up our muscles.
quests.funFact: Even animals like cats and dogs love a good stretch after a nap!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to enjoy a short cartoon before bedtime gets close"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: You might enjoy a cartoon or a favorite show during this time.
quests.explanation: Well done! A short show is a relaxing way to enjoy the evening.
quests.funFact: Balancing TV time with playing and reading helps keep your evening varied and fun!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to keep your hands clean after playing outside"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: It helps stop tiny, sneaky germs from spreading.
quests.explanation: Well done! Clean hands help stop germs before we eat or play.
quests.funFact: Clean hands are one of the best ways to stay healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to brush away bed head before the day starts"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: A small tool with teeth-like edges helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We comb our hair in the morning to look neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning when your alarm rings and your day begins"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: Your eyes open, and a brand new day is waiting for you.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waking up is the very first step of our morning routine.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!
